name: Waitress ☆ Panic!
original_name: ウェイトレス☆ぱにっく！
source:
Shinji's new coworker at his restaurant job, a girl named Futaba, is an unbelievable, refined beauty!

There's just one thing... she has absolutely not aptitude for waiting tables. Shinji has to follow her around all day to show her the ropes. One day Futaba spills hot coffee on a customer's lap. Shinji takes her place, working overtime and even writing an apology on her behalf.

"I'm so sorry, because of me, you had to..."
"Instead of an apology, think about how to avoid the same thing happening again."

Shinji's reply was a little colder than he meant it to be...

"Should I have... licked it?"

"wut."

"Well, they say that saliva helps with burns, so I thought that if someone gets burned it might be good to hurry and lick the affected area."

Well that's crazy. Shinji couldn't believe what he was hearing. And imagine his surprise when she started blowing him!

"I want to get better at my job... So please, give me some special training."

Creampies train her voice, sex outdoors helps with her shyness, and offering up herself on the menu makes for one wild waitressing experience! Depending on her training, you'll get one of two endings.

translation:
真嗣在餐厅工作的新同事，一个名叫双叶的女孩，是一位令人难以置信的精致美女！

只有一件事……她绝对没有当服务员的资质。真嗣必须整天跟着她，向她展示诀窍。有一天，双叶将热咖啡洒在一位顾客的腿上。真嗣取代了她的位置，加班加点，甚至还代她写了道歉信。

“真的很抱歉，因为我，你不得不……”
“与其道歉，不如想想如何避免同样的事情再次发生。”

真嗣的回答比他预想的要冷一些……

“我应该……舔它吗？”

“呜。”

“嗯，他们说唾液有助于治疗烧伤，所以我想如果有人被烧伤，最好赶紧舔一下受影响的区域。”

嗯，这太疯狂了。真嗣简直不敢相信自己所听到的。想象一下当她开始给他吹气时他的惊讶！

“我想在工作上做得更好……所以请给我一些特殊的培训。”

体内射精可以训练她的声音，户外性爱可以帮助她缓解害羞，而在菜单上展示自己则可以带来一种狂野的女服务员体验！根据她的训练，你会得到两个结局之一。
